extracted.name: Extra-Virgin Olive Oil Dipping Sauce
extracted.description: Extra-virgin olive oil (EVOO) makes a great dip for bread when you add a variety of seasonings, including garlic and red pepper flakes.
instruction_lines: Stir olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, parsley, oregano, kosher salt, and black pepper together in a small bowl; marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
